title: ABU Zaria 2026/27 Post-UTME, Student Portal, Fees & Clearance
summary: Ahmadu Bello University publishes a 2026 Post-UTME portal and separate student portal for fee payment, registration and admission procedures. Its 8 October 2026 announcement concerns suspension of revised student charges, so a proposed new fee table should not be represented as a current invoice.
feeLabel: Student charges: check latest ABU payment invoice
feeNote: ABU posted an official notice titled 'Suspension of Implementation of Revised Student Charges' on 8 October 2026. The full amount and scope cannot be confirmed from the text-only web version of that notice; do not apply a proposed increase or reuse an old charge as a verified universal 2026/27 fee. The student's active ABU invoice controls.
timeline: The university published an update to its 2026 Post-UTME screening on 9 October; verify the current examination and application instructions directly from the linked notice and admission portal, rather than assuming the old dates remain active.
requirements: JAMB UTME registration number and the candidate's authentic state-of-origin information for ABU's Post-UTME login.
O-level or relevant A-level results uploaded accurately to the official JAMB and university candidate records.
Eligibility for the selected ABU course and entry route, as stated in the university's current admission brochure.
For newly admitted students, accepted JAMB CAPS status, university admission records and the identity/credential documents requested by the academic registration unit.
steps: Open Ahmadu Bello University's official October 2026 Post-UTME announcement and check its current screening instructions before entering details in the application portal.
Visit the ABU Post-UTME form at portal.abu.edu.ng/forms/putme and sign in with the JAMB registration number and state of origin in the format shown by the university.
During an authorised registration window, confirm the candidate details and uploaded O-level/A-level results, complete the application and retain its submission confirmation.
Check the admission decision using official ABU communications and JAMB CAPS rather than a message from an agent or a paid shortlist group.
After a confirmed offer, follow the university's student portal to obtain the acceptance, registration and applicable faculty instructions, then generate a current personalised fee invoice.

Before paying tuition or other charges, read ABU's 8 October notice about revised charges and compare the actual university-generated invoice with the latest registration bulletin; save the official receipt and complete course registration.
notes: ABU's 8 October 2026 revised-charges suspension notice is a reason to avoid quoting any unverified current fee figure; it does not itself provide a universally confirmed price in the accessible page text.
ABU's 9 October 2026 Post-UTME notice is supplied as images on its website; the registration calendar must be checked directly rather than restated without verification.
The official Post-UTME portal states that candidate login uses the JAMB number and state of origin, and that Direct Entry instructions can follow a separate ongoing process.
School charges, accommodation, application charges and other faculty-specific payments must be identified separately on the student's actual university invoice.
Do not share student passwords, SMS codes or payment authorisation with intermediaries.

title: UNILORIN 2026/27 Admission Screening, Student Portal & School Fees
summary: University of Ilorin's 2026/27 Pre-Admission Screening charged ₦2,000 for registration and concluded its extended application window on 9 August, followed by screening tests on 13–15 August. Admission decisions require JAMB CAPS verification; students should use their own university invoices for acceptance and school charges.
feeNote: The university's 2026/27 registration instructions specify ₦2,000 for pre-admission screening, not annual tuition, hostel, technology charges or acceptance. No single current 2026/27 undergraduate school-fee amount was established by the reviewed materials.
timeline: University announcement dated 2 August extended screening registration to 9 August 2026; examination slips could be printed from 10 August and Post-UTME tests were scheduled 13–15 August. All dates are in the past.
requirements: JAMB registration record with UNILORIN and the correct programme/course selection for the 2026 admission route.
A personal active email address, a personal mobile phone number and a National Identification Number as set out in the university's instructions.
O-level result checker information and, for Direct Entry candidates, relevant A-level records uploaded on JAMB CAPS.
Candidate's examination or admission slips and original qualifications for the university's later document verification and student registration.
steps: Read UNILORIN's 2026/27 pre-admission registration notice and the university's August deadline update before attempting the admission portal.
Open portal.unilorin.edu.ng/ug/admissions, select the 2026/27 applicant category and confirm that your JAMB and contact records match the university's instructions.
During an authorised screening window, enter the requested NIN, email, personal phone, O-level information and applicable A-level records; verify the data before any submission.
Pay the university-issued ₦2,000 screening invoice only if the application window is open, then print the completed screening acknowledgement and scheduled test slip.

Following the screening, check the university's admission announcements and JAMB CAPS for a genuine offer; process any required course change in JAMB rather than inventing a different university-only route.

Once admitted, obtain the current school-specific student account and invoiced acceptance/registration charges from the university portal, pay only verified institutional invoices, and complete credential clearance and course registration.
notes: The original PDF gave 5 July as the registration close, but the later official university announcement extended it to 9 August; use the newer official notice.

The screening instructions state an admission evaluation weighting of UTME/A-level 50%, Post-UTME screening 30% and relevant O-level grades 20%; this is not a guarantee that an applicant will be admitted.
University of Ilorin warned applicants in August 2026 about fee-demanding admission fraudsters; paying a purported admission fixer is not part of the formal process.
The screening fee must not be quoted as full school fees, clearance or hostel charges.

title: FUOYE 2026/27 CASAPS Admission, Acceptance, Screening & Clearance
summary: Federal University Oye-Ekiti now uses CASAPS to show 2026/27 admission status, approved acceptance/screening invoices, result verification and the transition to SmartCampus. The university's live portal warns that some candidates owe programme-specific balances, so a flat acceptance or screening amount may be incomplete.
feeLabel: Acceptance and screening: programme-specific CASAPS invoice
feeNote: FUOYE's current CASAPS warning names candidates who paid ₦70,000 acceptance or ₦5,000 screening but still have an outstanding programme-specific balance. Those example payments are NOT confirmed final universal tuition, acceptance or screening amounts. The portal invoice and current programme rules control.
timeline: CASAPS posted an 11 October 2026 UTME admission-status update and offers applications for separately named programmes. This does not mean that all undergraduate UTME applications remain open; inspect the specific listed admission route.
requirements: JAMB registration number or issued application number for the correct 2026/27 FUOYE admission route.
Candidate's name and saved programme-selection data for matching the existing university admissions record.
WAEC, NECO or NABTEB result information, examination year and result-checker PIN/serial where the university requests online result verification.
A private email/contact method for official CASAPS or SmartCampus communications, and personal payment receipts for each separate fee category.
steps: Open FUOYE's official CASAPS portal and select Check Admission Status, using the issued JAMB or application number and the name required by the university.
If offered admission, sign in to the CASAPS Student Login area and review the populated JAMB and candidate profile before saving any corrections.
Visit the official CASAPS payment area and generate the exact acceptance and screening balances for your programme; do not assume ₦70,000 and ₦5,000 are the complete final charges.
After paying through the university's Central Payment System, return to the dashboard to confirm each transaction and keep separate proof of acceptance, screening and other charges.
Complete result verification using the examination number, year and authorised result-checker PIN/serial, then submit the completed admission record and download the university letter.

Move to the linked SmartCampus onboarding process for the session's student registration, medical screening, fees and course registration; check individual charges rather than paying through a WhatsApp intermediary.
notes: The CASAPS public portal listed 10 different applications on 12 October 2026; some are postgraduate, JUPEB, pre-degree, sandwich or part-time, and cannot be treated as regular UTME admissions.
The live October CASAPS advisory refers to outstanding differences after ₦70,000/₦5,000 payments. Never assume those displayed example payments equal the final charges for every programme.

FUOYE's official 2026/27 screening application guide stated ₦2,000 UTME/DE screening and ₦2,500 change-of-programme, but subsequent admitted-student CASAPS charges represent a different payment stage.

The acceptance, result verification, medical and academic-registration processes remain on official university platforms; do not disclose student portal passwords or examination checker PINs to third parties.

title: EKSU 2026/27 UTME/DE Screening, Student Portal, JUPEB & Clearance
summary: Ekiti State University publicly announced a 2026/27 UTME and Direct Entry screening exercise and provides its own admissions/student portal. JUPEB uses a separate 2026/27 application route; neither screening status nor JUPEB registration alone confirms admission or a universal school-fee amount.
feeLabel: 2026/27 fees: check current EKSU application invoice
feeNote: The publicly accessible 2026/27 admission notice is image-led, and no authoritative university-wide tuition or screening price was verifiable from its readable text. Check the amount printed on EKSU's live programme-specific invoice; do not use a 2025/26 price or a third-party social post.
timeline: EKSU's 2026/27 undergraduate UTME and DE screening notice was published 2 July 2026. Recheck the application stage and deadline in the official admissions link; the public news article does not expose a reliable updated closing date in readable text.
requirements: JAMB UTME or Direct Entry registration and correct EKSU programme choice for the relevant 2026/27 entry route.
Accurate personal name, current email and telephone number for the university's own applicant account.
Relevant O-level subject results and, for Direct Entry/JUPEB candidates, the entry qualification appropriate to the selected programme.
For an admitted applicant, verified JAMB CAPS record and institution-issued payment and clearance instructions identifying the correct academic session.
steps: Open EKSU's official website and follow its 2026/27 UTME/Direct Entry screening announcement before starting any application.
Select the university admissions link or sign-in portal reached through eksu.edu.ng, and confirm the academic session and examination route.
Enter the correct JAMB and examination details and check the programme's published academic requirements before generating the university's specific payment invoice.
Pay only an invoice issued by EKSU's authorised portal, print the application acknowledgement and keep proof of any screening payment.
Check the official admissions decision and JAMB CAPS before taking any action that assumes admission; do not confuse JUPEB programme applications with UTME admission offers.

After admission, obtain the student fee bill for the academic session and follow the school's current credential verification, registration and clearance guidance; use the institutional student account rather than informal agents.
notes: The university's official 2 July 2026 page confirms a 2026/27 UTME/DE screening exercise but does not provide a readable universal fee table.
The separate EKSU 2026/27 JUPEB application instructions involve an email-verified account and programme-specific payment; JUPEB is not automatic first-year undergraduate admission.
Do not copy programme fees or entry conditions between EKSU, LASU or FUOYE just because they are state/federal universities.
The safe fee is the one shown for the programme and academic year in the official EKSU portal, not an externally circulated screenshot.
